metadata.title: SEG/EAGE 3-D Overthrust model: official distribution CD1 (Overthrust_3D_CD1.tar.gz)
metadata.description:
This record re-hosts files of the SEG open-data distribution of this model. The bucket that served them (https://s3.amazonaws.com/open.source.geoscience/open_data/seg_eage_models_cd/Overthrust_3D_CD1.tar.gz) stopped serving anonymous downloads in 2026; the data file here is byte-identical to the copy it served (SHA-256 in SHA256SUMS).

Overthrust_3D_CD1.tar.gz holds the 3-D velocity grid (3-D_Overthrust_Model_Disk1/3D-Velocity-Grid/overthrust.vites: raw big-endian IEEE float32, 801 x 801 x 187 cells at 25 m, m/s, x fastest), the model database and documentation of distribution CD 1, the SEG/EAGE 3-D Modeling Series No. 1 booklet, and the README and LICENSE of the SEG open-data release.
